actions.kind: Unbuilt scope signalled by the prototype (same trio appears on every list). Recommend: decide whether exports of portal-user PII are wanted at all
Unbuilt; with 8 rows it is invisible, with real data it is the paging control
Static decoration; correct for one page, unbuilt otherwise

validation.rule: Free text; substring match; empty shows all rows; max 100 characters (same PROPOSED list-search limit as SCR-06/10/11/13; see OQ-20-12)
Closed set: 10 or 25, default 10; currently wired to nothing
Required (trimmed; whitespace-only is empty). Max 60 characters after trim; Unicode letters, space, hyphen, apostrophe (O'Brien, Müller, Petra-Kene must pass)
validation.message: "First Name is required." / PROPOSED "First Name must be 60 characters or fewer."
"Last Name is required." / PROPOSED "Last Name must be 60 characters or fewer."

validation.rule: Required (trimmed); must match ^\S+@\S+\.\S+$ (type="email" plus regex in fieldError). Max 254 characters, stored lower-cased; unique among portal users, case-insensitive (server-side only)
validation.message: "Email is required." / "Please enter a valid email address." / PROPOSED "Email must be 254 characters or fewer." / PROPOSED "A user with this email already exists." (OQ-20-05)

validation.rule: Required (trimmed); digits only ^[0-9]+$ (no +, spaces, hyphens; inputmode="numeric"). Min 7, max 15 digits (E.164 maximum; shortest seed here is 9)
validation.message: "Phone No is required." / "Phone No must be digits only." / PROPOSED "Phone No must be 7 to 15 digits."

validation.rule: Optional free text, trimmed; max 200 characters
validation.message: PROPOSED "Address must be 200 characters or fewer."

validation.rule: Required; exactly one of Administrator, Violation manager; placeholder "Select role" is not a valid value
Optional; one of blank, 1, 2, 3 (the label carries a yellow "1–3" chip: the prototype itself marks this as PROPOSED/concept)

Required on Add (data-req added in openUser(-1); blur skipped for this field; "Password is required." is effectively never seen because Save is disabled while empty); optional on Edit (blank keeps the current password, hint text). When filled: min 12 and max 128 characters (UTF-16 units; "Maximum 128 characters." shown red when exceeded); at least one uppercase A–Z, one lowercase a–z, one digit, and one symbol from ! @ # $ % ^ & * ( ) _ + - = [ ] { } \| ; ' : " , . < > ? (all ASCII-only; space, backtick, tilde, slash, backslash do not count; the UI shows only "(!@#$…)" so the permitted set is invisible). All five met and not over 128 enables Save; otherwise "Password does not meet all the requirements." Not equal to name/email, not on a breached list, not equal to the last N passwords
validation.message: rows "At least 12 characters", "An uppercase letter (A–Z)", "A lowercase letter (a–z)", "A number (0–9)", "A special character (!@#$…)"; "Maximum 128 characters."; "Password does not meet all the requirements."

validation.rule: Meaning (what does Level 1/2/3 permit, does it gate violation review severity 0–3 on the Violations screen)
No country-code rule although seeds mix local and full international numbers (123456789 vs 18763831676)

acceptance_criteria.title: List renders the eight seed users

steps.text: I am signed in and open Admin user List
the page loads
the table lists 8 rows with S No 1 to 8, the first row reads Ronald / Stephen / ronaldstephen@myambergroup.com / 123456789 / Bangalore / Administrator
the footer reads "Showing 1 to 8 of 8 entries" and Previous and Next are disabled

acceptance_criteria.title: Search filters rows as I type

steps.text: the list shows 8 rows
I type "level" into Search users
only the Level2 Admin and Level1 Admin rows remain visible
clearing the box with the ✕ shows all 8 rows again
I press ＋ Add User
the dialog appears
the title is "Add User", Role reads Administrator, all other fields are empty and Save is disabled
the five password rules are unticked and the meter is grey

acceptance_criteria.title: Password checklist turns green rule by rule

steps.text: the Add User dialog is open
I type the password "Abcdefghijk1!" in the Password field
all five rules are ticked green, the label reads "Strong", and (once the other required fields are valid) Save becomes enabled
typing "abcdefghijkl" instead leaves Save disabled with only "At least 12 characters" and "A lowercase letter (a–z)" ticked
the Add User dialog holds First "Test", Last "User", Email "test.user@ta.org.jm", Phone "8761234567", Role Violation manager, Level 2 and a policy-compliant password
I press Save
the dialog closes, a 9th row "Test User" appears, the footer reads "Showing 1 to 9 of 9 entries"
a toast reads User "Test User" added successfully.
the Add User dialog is open
I focus Email, type "abc" and tab away
"Please enter a valid email address." shows under Email with a red ring
typing in the field removes that message immediately

acceptance_criteria.title: Edit keeps the password when left blank

steps.text: I press ✎ on the Ronald row
the dialog opens
the title is "Edit User", fields hold Ronald's values, the Password asterisk is hidden and the hint reads "Leave blank to keep the current password."
changing Address to "Kingston" and pressing Save updates that row and shows User "Ronald Stephen" updated successfully.

acceptance_criteria.title: Delete asks the browser to confirm

steps.text: the list shows 8 rows
I press 🗑 on Vernon and accept the browser prompt "Delete user Vernon Walters?"
the row disappears, the remaining rows renumber 1 to 7 and the footer reads "Showing 1 to 7 of 7 entries"
dismissing the prompt instead leaves all 8 rows

acceptance_criteria.title: Reset password is a toast only

steps.text: the list is shown
I press 🔒 on any row
a toast reads "Password reset link sent (concept)."
no row data changes

acceptance_criteria.title: Escape and backdrop discard the dialog

steps.text: the Edit User dialog has an unsaved change
I press Esc
the dialog closes and reopening the same row shows the original values
